g.text: Roadster Flight Lab 3.11 | Measured road response

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526474

g.text: Matched protocol per pair: 1 s pedal settling → 4 s steering → 1 s settling. Shading marks the measured interval.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: All cases use full normalized steering input with each solver's speed-dependent wheel-angle mapping. The 90 km/h wet case holds throttle at 0.02 during steering.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Speeds are measured, not constrained: full throttle accelerates the 3.11 car from 54.14 to 84.65 km/h; cornering TCS limits torque for the entire 4 s.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526474

g.text: Numerical fixed-step solver · 120 Hz statistics / 20 Hz curves · flat world · no keyboard/camera, WebGL or FPS verdict. Peaks come from the 120 Hz record.
